records.name: New City Fellowship
records.pastor_credentials: Unknown — James River Presbytery ordained PCA minister

score_notes.christology: PCA affiliation means full Nicene orthodoxy; Christ as only Savior is foundational.
score_notes.scripture: PCA's Westminster Standards affirm full inerrancy; church website explicitly quotes Deuteronomy 8:3 regarding 'every word that comes from the mouth of the LORD' and anticipates hearing 'a word from the Lord' each Sunday through expository preaching. Rock solid.
score_notes.gender: PCA (Presbyterian Church in America) denominationally requires male-only ordained offices (elders, deacons). Complementarian (halfway house — not fully patriarchal) polity is enforced at the James River Presbytery level, not just local preference. One of the most structurally solid gender positions on this list.
score_notes.leadership: PCA polity requires a plurality of male elders with full accountability to James River Presbytery. Excellent structure.
score_notes.soteriology: Westminster Standards (which PCA affirms) are the most thorough articulation of Reformation soteriology — faith alone, by grace alone, in Christ alone.
score_notes.cultural: No DEI/CRT framing found. Cross-cultural emphasis is missional ('every nation, tribe, people, and language') — explicitly tied to Great Commission, not social justice ideology.
score_notes.preaching: Website explicitly describes expository preaching ministry: 'God speaks through the ministry of preaching... the Holy Spirit gives us ears to hear the Gospel of Jesus Christ proclaimed from every page of Scripture.' This is expository DNA stated outright.
score_notes.mission: Vision: 'make disciples from every nation, tribe, people, and language reflecting the grace, mercy, and justice of God in our communities, our nation, and our world.' Great Commission + global mission is central.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Sunday School classes for all ages, care groups — no standalone men's discipleship ministry confirmed.
score_notes.denominational: PCA — one of the strongest conservative Reformed denominations in the U.S. James River Presbytery accountability. Full Westminster Confession alignment.
